## W08 Human-authored Definition of Done

W08   Workflow ID __________   Version/date __________   Status __________

Prepared by __________   Accountable owner __________   Evidence location __________

Done when: the named human has written and signed the tests before any AI use; the count meets the tier; the challenge questions are answered; and the agreed version is frozen.

Source basis: [Definition of Done](https://github.com/rolldabones/definition-of-done) · [Slow AI Kitchen](https://github.com/rolldabones/slow-ai-kitchen)

The named human authors the actual tests before AI touches the task. AI may challenge a human-written definition; it may not supply that first definition or make the final confirmation.

**Hard constraints and tolerable trade-offs**

State which failures prohibit release. Add tests as needed: 1 to 3 at Tier 1; 3 to 7 at Tiers 2 and 3.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Challenge the definition before work begins**

What important option was discarded? Who structured the choices? Which trade-off is hidden? What failure disappears inside the average? How will unknowns be handled?

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Human author/date __________________  Reviewer/date __________________

Freeze the agreed version for the test. Any later amendment requires a reason, explicit approval, impact review and appropriate retesting; preserve the original results.
